name: Ciriaco Bardales — an earlier partner, Carmen Morales, and an infant son who died in 1905
researcher_question: Before his marriage to Clara Amelia Palacios Oliva, did Ciriaco Bardales have a son by a Carmen Morales — an infant Ciriaco who died 12 August 1905 in Guatemala City?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 14, hint-samples.csv row 422, flags adds_spouse/adds_son, confidence 3). ADJUDICATED: true match at PROBABLE confidence; the mandatory second opinion is still outstanding and is named in README.md "Notes for reviewers" when given. Adjudicated on the register images, not the index. The hint's death partida (ark:/61903/1:1:6D38-BQ8L) and an independent birth registration of the same infant (ark:/61903/1:1:6KNJ-27P8) agree on the address, name Carmen Morales as the mother, call both parents "solteros", and give the father's origin as Chiquimula — matching the subject's own 1933 death entry (ark:/61903/1:1:Z9YP-SKN2: aged 63, Coronel, son of Josefa Bardales, originario de Esquipulas, Chiquimula). The same couple had an earlier son in 1896 (ark:/61903/1:1:6K2Q-S4B2), making this a nine-year relationship. UNRESOLVED: that 1896 entry says the couple were natives of Guatemala City, not Chiquimula, contradicting the field the identification rests on; it is argued down as clerical boilerplate, not eliminated. See README "The unresolved tension".
